title: infra.alert.firing payload
description: Generic payload accepted from any external alerting system that fans out to Yggdrasil via POST /api/v1/events. Grafana, Prometheus Alertmanager, Sentry, custom webhooks, etc. The shape mirrors Grafana's Alertmanager-compatible webhook to keep the most common publisher zero-config: receiver/status/alerts/groupLabels/commonLabels/commonAnnotations. Anything outside that vocabulary is allowed — workflows that consume this event read what they need from event.payload via template paths.
